title: Circles of Waiting
statementMd:
A chip was placed on a field with coordinate system onto point $(0, 0)$.

Every second the chip moves randomly. If the chip is currently at a point $(*x*, *y*)$, after a second it moves to the point $(*x* - 1, *y*)$ with probability $*p*_{1}$, to the point $(*x*, *y* - 1)$ with probability $*p*_{2}$, to the point $(*x* + 1, *y*)$ with probability $*p*_{3}$ and to the point $(*x*, *y* + 1)$ with probability $*p*_{4}$. It's guaranteed that $*p*_{1} + *p*_{2} + *p*_{3} + *p*_{4} = 1$. The moves are independent.

Find out the expected time after which chip will move away from origin at a distance greater than $*R*$ (i.e. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9f4670fa50106dc217721881b50d148d5cb411e6.png) will be satisfied).

## Input

First line contains five integers $*R*, *a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, *a*_{3}$ and $*a*_{4}$ ($0 ≤ *R* ≤ 50, 1 ≤ *a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, *a*_{3}, *a*_{4} ≤ 1000$).

Probabilities $*p*_{*i*}$ can be calculated using formula ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/65ccb7dfe60ba768ddd49ae4fc254f5cf595d980.png).

## Output

It can be shown that answer for this problem is always a rational number of form ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b795551c4ba5b501281e7063ac11feb87c7f234f.png), where ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/deeb778b5db74d34de7beb4fe39bce44379acd40.png).

Print $*P*·*Q*^{ - 1}$ modulo $10^{9} + 7$.

## Note

In the first example initially the chip is located at a distance $0$ from origin. In one second chip will move to distance $1$ is some direction, so distance to origin will become $1$.

Answers to the second and the third tests: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4698d4bc5d3f09c8d2261ff8d109754f88454614.png) and ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/43b509b340db034f967064e721a5926972df0e73.png).
statementZhMd:
一枚棋子被放置在带有坐标系的平面上的点 $(0, 0)$ 处。

每秒棋子都会随机移动。如果棋子当前位于点 $(*x*, *y*)$，那么一秒后它以概率 $*p*_{1}$ 移动到点 $(*x* - 1, *y*)$，以概率 $*p*_{2}$ 移动到点 $(*x*, *y* - 1)$，以概率 $*p*_{3}$ 移动到点 $(*x* + 1, *y*)$，以概率 $*p*_{4}$ 移动到点 $(*x*, *y* + 1)$。保证 $*p*_{1} + *p*_{2} + *p*_{3} + *p*_{4} = 1$。每次移动相互独立。

求棋子移动到距离原点大于 $*R*$ 的位置（即满足 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9f4670fa50106dc217721881b50d148d5cb411e6.png)）所需时间的期望值。

## 输入格式

第一行包含五个整数 $*R*, *a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, *a*_{3}$ 和 $*a*_{4}$（$0 ≤ *R* ≤ 50, 1 ≤ *a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, *a*_{3}, *a*_{4} ≤ 1000$）。

概率 $*p*_{*i*}$ 可以通过以下公式计算：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/65ccb7dfe60ba768ddd49ae4fc254f5cf595d980.png)。

## 输出格式

可以证明，本题答案始终是形如 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b795551c4ba5b501281e7063ac11feb87c7f234f.png) 的有理数，其中 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/deeb778b5db74d34de7beb4fe39bce44379acd40.png)。

输出 $*P*·*Q*^{ - 1}$ 对 $10^{9} + 7$ 取模后的结果。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，初始时棋子到原点的距离为 $0$。一秒后，棋子会沿某个方向移动到距离原点为 $1$ 的位置，因此它到原点的距离将变为 $1$。

第二个和第三个测试的答案分别为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4698d4bc5d3f09c8d2261ff8d109754f88454614.png) 和 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/43b509b340db034f967064e721a5926972df0e73.png)。
